images.title: A 2 l jug and a 250 ml cup together
images.purpose: Show that the capacity of a container is its top mark and that two containers add: 2 l and 250 ml make 2 l 250 ml, which is 2,250 ml.
images.composition: A jug and a cup side by side with a plus sign, and two result boxes at the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. JUG on the left, base on y 600: an upright jug 220 px wide and 330 px tall, x 190 to 410, y 270 to 600, filled pale teal #CCE5F2 with a 4 px outline #1F2937, with a scale of 5 short marks (24 px) on its right inside edge and a long top mark (44 px) at y 290 labelled 2 l (40 px, bold, dark #1F2937). PLUS SIGN: the sign + (72 px, bold, dark #1F2937) at x 540, y 440. CUP, base on y 600: a cup 110 px wide at the top and 80 px at the bottom, 120 px tall, x 640 to 750, y 480 to 600, filled pale amber #FBE7C0 with a 4 px outline #1F2937, with a top mark labelled 250 ml (32 px, bold, dark) just above it at y 450. RESULT BOX at the right, a rounded rectangle 520 by 120 px at x 860 to 1380, y 300 to 420 with a 4 px outline #0072B2 containing the text 2 l 250 ml (60 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Under it, a second rounded rectangle 520 by 120 px at x 860 to 1380, y 460 to 580 with a 4 px outline #E69F00 containing the text 2,000 + 250 = 2,250 ml (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of containers that differs from 1 jug and 1 cup
the labels on the wrong containers
a total other than 2 l 250 ml and 2,250 ml
images.takeaway: A container's capacity is its top mark; add l with l and ml with ml, or change to ml: 2 l 250 ml is 2,250 ml.
images.description: A jug of 2 l and a cup of 250 ml with their total 2 l 250 ml, which is 2,250 ml.
images.context: Concept image for Mixed Capacities and Container Scales. It follows the idea of containers with scales in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Read the top mark of each container before adding. The slip to watch: writing 250 ml in the hundreds place of ml.

image_decisions.why: Two containers with their top marks show the capacities being added.
